question: The first nationalistic revolutionary movement in British India emerged from _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first nationalistic revolutionary movement in British India emerged from **Bengal**.
 
• During the late 19th and early 20th centuries, Bengal became the epicenter of revolutionary activities aimed at ending British colonial rule.
 
• Prominent revolutionary groups such as Anushilan Samiti and Jugantar were established in Bengal.</li&
